items.title: ESMO26: Standard dosing prevails over 12-week checkpoint inhibitors in MOIO trial
items.summary: Reduced-frequency checkpoint inhibitor treatment could not demonstrate non-inferior PFS and showed a signal of worse survival.

items.title: ESMO26: Intismeran sets new benchmark in adjuvant melanoma
items.summary: One notable finding from the INTerpath-001 trial, for which data was presented at ESMO 2026, was when the benefit appeared.

items.title: ESMO26: KEYNOTE-C93 backs chemo-free Keytruda in dMMR endometrial cancer
items.summary: Phase III results support chemotherapy-free first-line Keytruda in dMMR but leave the most clinically relevant comparison untested.

items.title: ESMO26: Sac-TMT sets survival benchmark in recurrent endometrial cancer
items.summary: Data for MSD and Kelun-Biotech's sac-TMT in endometrial cancer was presented at ESMO 2026.

items.title: Pfizer’s prostate cancer combo moves to earlier line on expanded US approval
items.summary: The FDA expands Talzenna-Xtandi's label as the cancer treatment paradigm shifts towards the use of mutation-specific targeted therapies.
